cases.title: I-Shaped Special Structural Shear Wall
cases.summary: An spColumn reference example for axial force and bending in an I-shaped reinforced concrete wall.
cases.description: This case compares the saved RETUG concreteJS wall model with StructurePoint’s spColumn control points. The plot shows the supplied 90° analysis: 100 nominal and factored profiles, including both moment directions. The bundled model includes all 16 published control points as demand checks.

source.title: StructurePoint — spColumn v10.10
source.report: DE Special Structural Shear Wall – Compressive Stress, ACI 318-19 (October 12, 2023)
source.page: spColumn report page 6 (PDF page 36), Control Points
